assessment.body:
## Verdict

agent_supports: yes
daemon_capability: full
driver_capability: gap:partner_tmux

## Reasoning

Different agents in one workspace: the daemon labels each adapter independently (disjoint process matchers and session sources; per-(adapter, session_id) state). An OpenCode 2.x session is labelled `opencode` and keyed by its ses_… id from the service's store; a Claude Code session in the same cwd is keyed by its transcript UUID. Neither source can see the other's sessions, so the arcs are independent — the daemon side needs nothing 2.x-specific, which is why `daemon_capability` stays full.

## Driver: host-limited gap, not a daemon incapability

The record asks run-cell-multi.sh to learn the column, with a partner on a real-home store (claudecode or codex) so the partner never talks to the local Kolibri model. It has learned it (#2109 P5b-1): the opencode-v2 store wipe and the no-tmux teardown exemption, tested without tmux (lib/run-cell-multi-opencode-v2_test.sh, lib/run-cell-multi-teardown_test.sh). But every candidate partner's driver launches its CLI in tmux, and the recording host has no tmux: `command -v tmux` exits 1, and lines matching `(^|[^a-z_])tmux ` in replaydata/agents/<a>/driver-interactive.sh number claudecode 37, codex 49, pi 32, aider 14 (opencode-v2: 0). So the rig cannot drive the partner on this host, and the cell stays unrecorded. On a host with tmux the recipe below records as is.
caveats: Host-limited: the partner's driver needs tmux and the recording host has none (`command -v tmux` exit 1; partner drivers' `tmux ` line counts claudecode 37, codex 49, pi 32, aider 14). Installing tmux is out of scope by decision.
The partner (claudecode) uses its own real-home store and model, never the sandbox's Kolibri.

sources.note: 2.x reader: lists session_v2 rows with time_archived IS NULL; a session is admitted on its first session_message activity while a service is up (#2107); an archived or missing row emits EventRemoved (v2SessionGone)
servicePIDFor: a session no client runs binds to the one running service; OwnsSharedPID answers false for an archived row
the cross-adapter rig: drives every adapter's driver-interactive.sh concurrently in one cwd; learned the opencode-v2 store wipe and the no-tmux teardown exemption (#2109 P5b-1)
the partner's driver launches claude in tmux (37 matching lines)

preconditions: One OpenCode 2.x `serve --service` running, with a model it can reach (this host: the sandbox service, local Kolibri-1 4-bit model (mlx_lm) at 127.0.0.1:8087); the rig never starts, stops or reconfigures it
The three XDG exports, coexist IRRLICHT_ONBOARD_HOME and a non-7837 bind address from replaydata/agents/opencode-v2/prerequisites.md; OPENCODE_DB unset
setup: driver-interactive.sh (API driver) refuses before creating anything unless exactly one `serve --service` runs, its environment carries the run's XDG_* values, and the plugin's beacon resolves this run's daemon

It creates one session over POST /api/session at <staging>/cwd, waits for the service log to show the plugin the daemon installed loading for that location with no load failure, then drives the script; the session's session_message rows are exported read-only as the transcript
run-cell-multi.sh drives this driver and the partner's concurrently in one shared cwd under one recording daemon
the partner (claudecode) runs on its own real-home store and model, never on the sandbox's Kolibri
settings deny the shell tool in RUN_CWD/opencode.json (a backstop: the local model reached for it in a no-tool turn once)

script.text: Reply with exactly the word: epsilon. Do not use any tools.

verify: two distinct sessions of two adapters in the same cwd, each with its own working → ready arc
no cross-contamination of state or metrics
